name: auth
title: Auth
description: Better Auth with email and password, sessions in D1, rate-limited sign-in and sign-up.

APP_URL.description: Public origin of the app, e.g. https://app.example.com

TRUSTED_ORIGINS.description: Extra origins allowed to call the auth API, comma-separated

TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: Turnstile site key (public). With TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY, sign-up needs a Turnstile token; the example is Cloudflare's always-pass test key

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Signs sessions; at least 32 random characters

TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.description: Turnstile secret key; the example is Cloudflare's always-pass test secret, never use it in production
